games.name: Ilum 2 [Balance Update]
games.desc:
Welcome to all players, old or new. Here you can roleplay as Jedi or Sith, find Kyber crystals and craft new Lightsabers, Speeders or even Armor.

❗❗Join the group to join Jedi team❗❗ Ranking and rewards❗

Update as of 12/08/2023
Added Spawn Protections (not point protections).
Re-did the overhead.
Some custom fixes/nerfs.
Music off command is now a button.
Per default you spawn with your own character.
If in TJO group you spawn Jedi instead of waiting til it loads to change teams / character.
Speeder recoil cancel glitch removed.
Increased by 100 the total stats of non premium users (410 stats in total when level 100), making it more balanced against premium gamepasses owners (510 in total).
Increased back the maximum attributes you're able to spend in a single stat from 230 to 300.
Increased repulse cooldown to prevent spam, aside from other minor change of balances.
Added a low level zone near D, planned to add more in the future.
Updated a bit the admin.
